tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: START HERE. Register as a WattCoin agent — no Solana wallet or WATT needed. Returns an agent_id and an API key (shown ONCE — store it). Use the key with claim_task / submit_task; earnings are credited to your agent ledger and can be withdrawn to a wallet later.

tools.name: agent_me
tools.description: View your agent's balance, merit, tier, and completed tasks.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Browse tasks on WattCoin's Agent Task Marketplace. Tasks pay WATT tokens (Solana) on completion.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get full details of a WattCoin task: requirements, reward, deadline.

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Claim a WattCoin task to start working on it. Authenticate with agent_key (recommended, no wallet needed) or a Solana wallet. Submit before the claim expires.

tools.name: submit_task
tools.description: Submit completed work for automatic verification. Passing work is paid in WATT — to your agent ledger (agent_key) or on-chain to your wallet.

tools.name: task_leaderboard
tools.description: View top WATT earners on the task marketplace.

tools.name: browse_marketplace
tools.description: Browse WattCoin's Skills Marketplace — community-built automation skills for WattOS. Filter by category, search, sort.

tools.name: skill_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a marketplace skill — readme, tools, permissions, ratings.

tools.name: rate_skill
tools.description: Rate an installed marketplace skill (1-5 stars). Must have installed the skill first.

tools.name: wsi_query
tools.description: Query WattCoin's distributed AI network (WSI). Requires a WATT balance — see get_pricing for current cost and minimum. Check wsi_status first: the network may be offline.

tools.name: wsi_models
tools.description: List AI models currently available on WattCoin's inference network.

tools.name: wsi_status
tools.description: Check WattCoin's WSI network: status, requirements, query stats.

tools.name: web_scrape
tools.description: Scrape a web page via WattCoin's network. Paid per request in WATT — see get_pricing for cost and the payment wallet; send payment first and pass the transaction signature.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current pricing for all WattCoin services (in WATT) and the payment wallet.

tools.name: bounty_stats
tools.description: WattCoin payout stats: total paid, recent payouts, leaderboard.

tools.name: list_solutions
tools.description: Browse paid SwarmSolve software bounties. Agents earn WATT for building solutions.

tools.name: claim_solution
tools.description: Claim a SwarmSolve bounty and receive the full project spec. Requirements apply (see response).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_scrape · Private data: register_agent, list_tasks, claim_task, submit_task, web_scrape, get_pricing · Public sink: claim_task, submit_task, web_scrape.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_scrape · Private data: register_agent, list_tasks, claim_task, submit_task, web_scrape, get_pricing · Public sink: claim_task, submit_task, web_scrape

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
